Subject: Redwood AP requirements for vendor activation (quick list)

Hi Elias — copying the terse AP checklist here so you have everything in one place. Grace, add these to the vendor record when you can.

Required for vendor activation and first payment:
• Completed W‑9 (we received) — legal name must match tax records.
• Proof of legal formation (Articles) — received.
• Remittance instructions: bank name, account number, routing/IBAN, account holder name, and SWIFT if using wire.
• Billing address exactly as it should appear on invoices.
• Primary invoice delivery method: email (invoices@redwood.com), vendor portal upload, or EDI. If email, we only accept invoices as PDF attachments.

Invoice formatting notes:
• Include Redwood PO number prominently on the first page (format: PO‑#######).
• Include invoice number and invoice date.
• Line‑level SKU or service description preferred; totals must match.

Operational items:
• We'll provision vendor code VN‑7821 once remittance details + confirmed legal name are on file.
• Payment terms default to Net‑30 unless otherwise negotiated with your sales contact.

If you prefer, we can send a vendor portal invite so you can upload the W‑9/Articles and populate remittance fields directly.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
AP Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
